column5: Look: side-view pixel art following `design/art/sprite-style-guide.md`: muted pond-bank backdrop (dusky greens, teal water), a vivid green frog with a red headband and twig sword, each bug one colour family, gold coins and white hit sparks as the most saturated things on screen, 1px near-black outlines on all characters. Signature detail: combos flash their name in a banner and change the frog's look. Every figure drawn, no emoji, no plain circles.
References: Capybara Go (auto-advance + 1-of-3 picks), Legend of Mushroom (watching duels), Vampire Survivors (evolve recipes shown on cards).
View: 2D · Camera: static side view; the path scrolls past.
Auto-walking side-view run (~4 min) with health, run timer and stop counter
4 bug kinds, each attacking differently: Beetle (tough, slow), Mosquito (fast, weak), Spitter Bug (ranged), Mantis mini-boss; plus the Hornet Shogun boss
Pick-1-of-3 technique cards (about 8 techniques), held ones level up
4–5 named combos, shown as recipes on the cards, with a banner and a visible change when formed
Coins + bug materials earned in the run, kept on a fall
Between-runs crafting screen: 3 gear pieces (lily-pad armour, reed spear, beetle-shell guard) that carry over, saved in the browser
Tap to speed up fights
Auto-fight run · in the slice
Technique picks and combos · in the slice
Boss fight · in the slice
Crafting gear from bug materials · thin stand-in
The frog hops onto the pond path and duels a beetle on his own (tap anything to speed up).
After two fights the first "choose 1 of 3" pauses the game: Tongue Lash, Lily Leap, Rain Stance, each card saying what it does.
The next pick offers a technique whose card shows "+ Tongue Lash = Storm Tongue"; taking it fires the first combo banner and his attacks visibly change: the hook pays off.
First real trouble: a Mantis mini-boss around minute 2.
The Hornet Shogun boss around minute 4 usually beats a first run.
A fall keeps coins and bug materials; crafting one upgrade (e.g. lily-pad armour) makes run 2 winnable.
Fights get tougher stop by stop.
